description:
KeelBase4J — Java runtime for KeelBase. Phase-0 spike (feasibility probe):
    the protocol module reproduces the frozen AI Governance Protocol vectors; the runtime module
    is a minimal Spring Boot app whose AI operations run through the governance trust loop
    (Identity → Permission → Governance → Confirmation → Audit → Revoke); the generator module
    turns a business request into real, standalone Spring Boot source.
